title: Define architecture, domain model, and API contracts
scope: Document and validate the selected Flutter/Dart Android app, Next.js/TypeScript web back office, NestJS REST/OpenAPI modular backend, and PostgreSQL/Prisma database. Record architecture decisions before scaffolding.
acceptance: Model business, outlet, user, menu, variant, stock item, recipe, order, sale, payment record, stock movement, and print job.
Define versioned API contracts, money in integer minor units, decimal quantities, outlet timezone, and sale state transitions.
Document online-only MVP boundary, offline roadmap, deployment approach, and printer integration risks.
Record the selected stack in TECH_STACK.md and define Flutter UI/repository boundaries, shared OpenAPI contracts, and authoritative backend business rules.

title: Create minimalist design system and core flow prototypes
scope: Establish a slick, modern visual foundation shared across web management and Android cashier.
acceptance: Define neutral surfaces, one accent color, typography, spacing, icons, and reusable component states.
Prototype menu editing, stock adjustment, cashier cart, checkout, reports, and printer setup.
Provide accessible contrast, keyboard support on web, large touch targets, loading/empty/error states, and compact/expanded layouts.

title: Scaffold Next.js web, Flutter Android app, NestJS API, and PostgreSQL
scope: Create the selected stack with pnpm workspaces for TypeScript apps, Flutter tooling for mobile, Prisma migrations, local Docker Compose, and synthetic demo data.
acceptance: Web, Android, and API run using documented commands with validated environment examples.
Database migrations and a repeatable synthetic seed are included; no production credentials or data are committed.
CI builds apps and checks formatting, types, and critical domain tests.
Pin compatible stable dependencies; CI runs Next.js/NestJS checks and Flutter analyze/test/build. Generate or validate TypeScript and Dart contracts from OpenAPI.

title: Implement authentication, owner/cashier roles, and outlet isolation
scope: Provide minimum secure access for owner back office and cashier mobile app.
acceptance: Users can sign in and out; sessions expire and revoked access is rejected.
Backend authorizes every request and isolates business/outlet records.
Cashiers cannot edit stock, prices, permissions, or reports beyond their granted access; authentication is rate limited.

title: Build responsive back-office shell and business settings
scope: Implement navigation, account controls, and a single-outlet MVP configuration with extension points for more outlets.
acceptance: Owner can navigate Menu, Stock, Sales, Reports, and Printers with clear selected states.
Business name, receipt identity, currency, timezone, and configured tax/service rules are editable with validation.
Pages work on desktop and smaller screens; failed requests offer safe retry.

title: Implement menu categories, products, variants, and availability
scope: Create shared catalog APIs and owner-facing menu management.
acceptance: Owner can create, edit, archive, search, and categorize products with prices and variants.
Archived products remain readable on historical sales but cannot be newly sold.
Every purchasable variant has a stable ID and explicit stock policy; changes appear after Android catalog refresh.

title: Implement stock items, units, opening balances, and stock ledger
scope: Track inventory using auditable movements rather than directly overwriting balances.
acceptance: Owner can define stock items, base units, precision, opening quantities, and reorder thresholds.
Receipts and positive/negative adjustments require reason, actor, timestamp, outlet, and reference.
Balance equals the movement sum; invalid quantities and incompatible units are rejected.

title: Connect menu variants to stock through direct links and recipes
scope: Allow finished goods to consume a stock item and prepared menu items to consume multiple ingredients.
acceptance: Owner can link a variant directly to stock or define ingredient quantities per sold unit.
Unit conversion is explicit and validated; fractional ingredient consumption is supported.
Sale stock calculations use a snapshot of the applicable recipe; later recipe edits never rewrite historical consumption.

title: Implement sale calculation and payment recording API
scope: Record completed sales with cash or manually recorded external payment; integrated payment processing belongs in Phase 2.
acceptance: Server calculates item totals, configured tax/service charges, rounding, amount due, tender, and change.
Sale lines preserve product names, variant, price, and calculation rules as historical snapshots.
Insufficient cash, invalid totals, duplicate checkout keys with changed payloads, and unauthorized requests are rejected.

title: Deduct stock atomically and exactly once when a sale completes
scope: Make sale completion and its stock ledger entries a single database transaction.
acceptance: Selling 2 products consuming 3 units each reduces the stock balance by exactly 6.
Retries with the same checkout key return the original result and never duplicate sales or stock movements.
Concurrent sales cannot oversell when negative stock is blocked; failed transactions change neither sale nor stock.
Draft/cancelled carts do not deduct stock; menu availability reflects the limiting ingredient after refresh.

title: Build cashier app shell, catalog browsing, and cart
scope: Create a touch-friendly Android cashier UI for phone and tablet.
acceptance: Cashier can browse categories, search items, select variants, change quantity, and remove cart lines.
Unavailable items are visibly disabled and totals remain clear while editing.
Catalog refresh and expired-session handling preserve or explicitly resolve unsent cart work.

title: Connect checkout, completion receipt, and uncertain-outcome recovery
scope: Complete real API-backed cashier sales using cash or manual non-cash recording.
acceptance: Cashier can enter tender, view change, submit once, and see a sale reference and receipt.
Timeout recovery checks the existing checkout key before permitting a retry or new attempt.
Online-only MVP clearly blocks completion without a confirmed server connection; print failure never repeats checkout.

title: Build stock overview, receiving, adjustments, and low-stock states
scope: Expose connected stock and menu availability clearly in the back office.
acceptance: Owner can filter stock by status and inspect the full movement history with sale references.
Receiving and adjustments update balances and availability with reason capture and validation.
A completed mobile sale is reflected in the web stock view after refresh; raw stock and estimated sellable menu quantities are distinguished.

title: Build sales history, receipt detail, and basic daily reporting
scope: Provide owner reports from persisted sales, not client-side counters.
acceptance: Filter sales by outlet-local date and inspect line items, tender, tax/service, and sale reference.
Show gross sales, net sales, sale count, average bill, menu quantities, and payment-method totals with definitions.
CSV export matches filtered results and report totals reconcile to completed sales and stock movement references.

title: Validate printer hardware and implement Android receipt connection
scope: Choose and verify one actual printer model and transport for MVP; prefer a documented thermal receipt protocol where supported.
acceptance: Record model, paper width, encoding, command support, Android version, and required permissions.
Cashier can discover/configure the supported connection, connect, test print, and see actionable failure states.
Verify on real hardware; Bluetooth/LAN/USB are not all claimed supported unless individually tested. Additional transports belong in Phase 2.
Implement a Flutter printer adapter with Android runtime permissions and documented real-device verification.

title: Implement receipt layout, print queue, retry, and reprints
scope: Print persisted sale receipts with durable job state independent of checkout.
acceptance: Receipt shows identity, reference, local date, items, quantity, prices, tax/service, total, tender, and change.
Jobs survive app restart and expose queued/sent/failed or uncertain states; a disconnect does not lose the sale.
Manual reprint is marked COPY and audited; uncertain physical delivery is shown to the cashier rather than claiming guaranteed exactly-once paper output.

title: Implement controlled sale reversal and stock restoration
scope: Provide owner-only full sale reversal as the minimum safe correction path; complex refunds are deferred.
acceptance: Owner must supply a reason; original sale remains immutable and linked to its reversal.
Stock is restored only for returned/restockable goods selected under an explicit policy; consumed ingredients are not blindly replenished.
Repeated reversal requests do not repeat financial or stock movements; reports show reversals separately.
Manual non-cash reversal records do not claim money was returned by a payment provider.

title: Verify MVP end-to-end, deploy staging, and document ownership
scope: Prove the core sales, stock, reports, and printing loop before production use.
acceptance: Verify catalog setup to Android sale to stock deduction to report to real printed receipt.
Test concurrent stock contention, duplicate requests, checkout timeout, app restart, printer disconnect, and reversal.
Provide staging setup, Android build instructions, migration/backup/restore procedure, owner guide, and known limitations.
Use synthetic data; a production launch is a separate explicit release decision.

title: Add offline sales and reliable synchronization
scope: Design and implement explicit multi-device offline stock and conflict policy.
acceptance: Encrypted local storage persists pending orders and sales across restart.
Synchronization is idempotent, shows pending/conflict states, and reconciles reports and stock.
Document whether stock is reserved, allocated per device, or can oversell offline; verify reconnect and concurrent edits.

title: Add tables, open orders, item transfers, and split bills
scope: Extend counter sales to full dine-in workflows.
acceptance: Open and transfer table orders with permissions and an audit trail.
Split items/quantities across bills without duplicating payment or stock consumption.
Define reservation and cancellation behavior before final payment.

title: Add promotions, advanced modifiers, partial refunds, and approval rules
scope: Extend pricing and corrections with controlled rules.
acceptance: Support percentage/fixed promotions and explicit eligibility, stacking, and rounding rules.
Support partial item refunds with separate money-return and restock decisions.
Require elevated approval where configured and retain original sale snapshots and audit history.

title: Integrate QRIS or selected payment provider and reconciliation
scope: Choose a provider and implement actual online payment lifecycle separately from manual recording.
acceptance: Use provider sandbox, verified webhooks, idempotency, and explicit pending/succeeded/failed states.
Handle payment success with lost client connection and reconciliation without charging twice.
Validate refunds, settlement reporting, and credential storage; provider selection and commercial setup remain prerequisites.

title: Add shifts, cash reconciliation, attendance, and granular roles
scope: Support daily staff operation and cash accountability.
acceptance: Track opening float, cash in/out, expected cash, closing count, and discrepancies.
Separate attendance from cashier shifts and record accountable actors.
Add permission matrix, approval limits, shift reports, and audit search.

title: Add suppliers, purchase orders, stock counts, waste, and transfers
scope: Expand inventory purchasing and control beyond manual receiving.
acceptance: Support purchase order to partial receipt with unit conversion and supplier reference.
Stock count variance and waste generate ledger entries with reasons.
Outlet transfers preserve quantities through dispatched/received states without double counting.

title: Add kitchen routing and additional printer transports
scope: Extend the verified MVP receipt connection to kitchen stations and other tested hardware.
acceptance: Route menu items to stations and print amendments/cancellations with order references.
Validate each added Bluetooth/LAN/USB transport against documented supported hardware.
Queue and reprint station jobs independently without duplicating sales or stock deductions.

title: Add multi-outlet management, bookkeeping, and advanced reporting
scope: Extend the single-outlet foundation with consolidated management.
acceptance: Scope menus, prices, stock, staff, and reporting by outlet with consolidated owner views.
Define inventory costing and expense categories before presenting profit/margin figures.
Export auditable sales, reversal, payment, and accounting summaries with clear calculation definitions.

title: Add online ordering, customer records, and digital receipts
scope: Plan complementary ordering and customer-facing connections after the operational core.
acceptance: Select supported channels and define order acceptance, cancellation, payment, and stock ownership.
Deduplicate incoming orders and preserve channel references.
Add opt-in customer records and digital receipts with configurable retention and access controls.

title: Collect operator feedback and prioritize measured improvements
scope: Keep improvement scope open until real usage evidence exists.
acceptance: Observe cashier and owner workflows and record friction without collecting unnecessary customer data.
Define baselines for checkout time, errors, stock discrepancies, and support incidents.
Rank opportunities by user impact and effort; create approved implementation tickets before building.

title: Refine cashier speed and back-office usability from feedback
scope: Placeholder for validated UI improvements rather than predetermined feature promises.
acceptance: Choose improvements from the measured backlog and define success criteria.
Prototype and test with representative cashiers/owners across supported screen sizes.
Verify accessibility and demonstrate improvement against the selected baseline.

title: Improve performance and operational reliability from production evidence
scope: Address measured bottlenecks in synchronization, checkout, reports, or printing.
acceptance: Choose specific latency/failure targets from observed usage.
Implement changes with realistic load and failure recovery checks.
Verify no regression in stock integrity, sale idempotency, or historical report reconciliation.
